title: payment
description: One posted ledger change. Reversals are new rows; the original row stays. A failed collection is not proof of default.

due_at.description: Due date of the instalment that this entry relates to.

posted_at.description: Event time: when the ledger change was posted.

amount_due.description: Instalment due in GBP. Zero on reversal and manual-payment rows, so a sum over rows counts each instalment once.

amount_received.description: GBP received. Zero for a failed collection. Negative for a reversal.

reversal_of.description: entry_id of the reversed entry. Set only when entry_type is reversal.

reason_code.description: Failure reason for a failed collection, or reversal reason.
